results.content: Fearless is the second studio album by American singer-songwriter Taylor Swift, released in 2008. The album marked a significant step in Swift's transition from country music to pop, showcasing her ability to craft heartfelt lyrics about relationships and catchy melodies. Fearless debuted at number one on the Billboard 200 chart and spent more time at the top than any other album released that decade. Its singles, such as "You Belong with Me" and "Love Story," achieved widespread popularity.
